acceptance_criteria.fit: Observation kind, build/config/case/source/command/result provenance and artifact execution are explicit.
The actual https://localhost:2222 browser URL, HTTPS /ws upgrade/auth/router dispatch and production construction path are completion requirements.
Standalone injection is separately classified and cannot substitute for the production-path observation.
Mismatch rows and match|mismatch|not_exercised aggregation retain case/source/evidence provenance.
Disposition remains unresolved and split activation/SRS mutation is prohibited and reviewed.
TC-7004 runs separately as current viewport-only behavior and is not promoted to a retention promise.
24/1000/10000 lines and 2 MiB before/at/after are explicit characterization seeds.
Cache, view, text and buffer enumerations are required in deterministic cases and result rows.
Ordered lines, cell attributes, cursor/saved cursor, modes, buffer and geometry use the same pre/post schema and field verdicts.
Runtime/config boundary, cause signals and raw candidate-cause provenance are planned.
expected_current_eviction and observed_loss are separate tested analyzer outcomes and separate artifact totals.
Negative tests and review prohibit retained rows, aggregate memory, checkpoint budgets, recovery SLO and authority promotion.
All four mode IDs, disabled/retained layers, fixtures and control comparators are tested.
NO_RENDER, NO_ANALYZER, NO_NETWORK and two-or-more-client ONE_CLIENT_SLOW isolation are explicit.
Seed, payload/build/config provenance and deterministic manifest validation are assigned to RED/GREEN statistics contracts.
Session 1|8|32|54, client 1|2|8, workload provenance and one-client baseline exclusion are explicit.
Raw-before-summary, source sample IDs, p50/p95/p99, seeded CI and independent recomputation are enforced.
Existing observability snapshots are reused and interval delta, unit and source are required.
A negative contract and final review prohibit product threshold, SLO and resource/default promotion.
All three prerequisite Requirement IDs, artifact references, run/build IDs and digests are required before G1 input is valid.
The exact two-value enum has no default/fallback and the chosen and rejected branch evidence is recorded.
Bug-only requires a separate authorized ID, maximum one fix and inactive/deferred migration downstream state.
Migration cannot open wave 2 without an exact separate stable retained-state authority Requirement ID.
Authority promotion, UI change, legacy deletion and product defaults/budgets are denied throughout the gate and review tasks.
Decision, completeness, conditional ID, downstream state and denial reason are fields of the tested gate/record flow.

intentional_conditional_boundary.reason: The selected branch and separately authorized local-fix or stable-authority Requirement ID do not exist until prerequisite evidence is complete and the user explicitly decides. The plan correctly blocks instead of inventing a branch, product default, UI change or implementation scope.
